passage.label: An-Nisa — Worship Allah and associate nothing with Him; kindness to parents, relatives, orphans, needy, neighbors, travelers, and those whom right hands possess; do not be arrogant or boastful; those who are stingy and command stinginess and conceal what Allah gave them; those who spend to be seen by people and do not believe; what harm if they believed and spent; Allah does not wrong even atom's weight but multiplies good deeds; how will it be when We bring witnesses from every nation and you as witness against these; disbelievers will wish earth covered them

arabicExcerpts.text: ۞وَٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُشۡرِكُواْ بِهِۦ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَبِٱلۡوَٰلِدَيۡنِ إِحۡسَٰنٗا وَبِذِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَٱلۡيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلۡمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱلۡجَارِ ذِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَٱلۡجَارِ ٱلۡجُنُبِ وَٱلصَّاحِبِ بِٱلۡجَنۢبِ وَٱبۡنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُكُمۡۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ مَن كَانَ مُخۡتَالٗا فَخُورًا
ٱلَّذِينَ يَبۡخَلُونَ وَيَأۡمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلۡبُخۡلِ وَيَكۡتُمُونَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦۗ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٗا مُّهِينٗا
وَٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمۡوَٰلَهُمۡ رِئَآءَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَلَا بِٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِۗ وَمَن يَكُنِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ لَهُۥ قَرِينٗا فَسَآءَ قَرِينٗا
وَمَاذَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ لَوۡ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ وَأَنفَقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِمۡ عَلِيمًا
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَظۡلِمُ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖۖ وَإِن تَكُ حَسَنَةٗ يُضَٰعِفۡهَا وَيُؤۡتِ مِن لَّدُنۡهُ أَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا
فَكَيۡفَ إِذَا جِئۡنَا مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةِۭ بِشَهِيدٖ وَجِئۡنَا بِكَ عَلَىٰ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ شَهِيدٗا
يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَعَصَوُاْ ٱلرَّسُولَ لَوۡ تُسَوَّىٰ بِهِمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَلَا يَكۡتُمُونَ ٱللَّهَ حَدِيثٗا

mainSubject.label: Command to worship Allah alone without associating anything; ihsan (kindness) to parents, relatives, orphans, needy, near and far neighbors, companions, travelers, and those whom right hands possess; prohibition of arrogance and boastfulness (mukhtalan fakhuran); condemnation of those who are stingy, command stinginess, and conceal Allah's bounty; condemnation of those who spend only to be seen by people while disbelieving in Allah and Last Day; shaytan as evil companion; rhetorical question about harm avoided through belief and spending; Allah does not wrong even an atom's weight and multiplies good deeds giving great reward; eschatological scene of bringing witnesses from every nation and the Prophet as witness; disbelievers wishing earth would cover them, unable to conceal anything from Allah

notes: Pass A Nisa passage 5/8. Opens with comprehensive worship and social ethics command (4:36), listing ten categories of recipients for ihsan. Transitions to condemning three types of miserliness: hoarding (bukhl), commanding others to hoard, and showing off in spending (riya'). Eschatological climax (4:41-42) shifts to Day of Judgment witnesses and disbelievers' despair. Atom's weight justice principle (4:40) establishes divine precision.
